title: Jalapeno Popper Mexican Poblano Tlayudas
description: A spicy and savory Mexican dish featuring crispy bread rolls, gooey cheese, and a flavorful poblano sauce, perfect for energizing your day.
instructions: Roast the poblano peppers in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until charred and blistered.
Peel the roasted poblanos and place them in a blender or food processor.
Add the sour cream, cilantro, garlic, cumin, chili powder, salt, and black pepper to the blender and blend until smooth.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced jalapenos and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until they start to soften.
Add the sliced bread rolls to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until crispy and golden brown.
In a large bowl, combine the roasted poblanos, sour cream mixture, and Monterey Jack cheese.
Stir until the cheese is melted and the mixture is well combined.
Divide the mixture among the cooked bread rolls and top with additional cheese if desired.
Cover the tlayudas with aluminum foil and bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 5-10 minutes, or until the cheese is golden brown and the tlayudas are crispy.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
